title: Cut by a licence recipe
summary: Keeps only the sources a licence recipe of data/recipes/ admits, so the data fits the network's use.
does: Applies one recipe of data/recipes/: commercial admits open sources; commercial-share-alike adds share-alike ones; non-commercial adds non-commercial ones; research-internal adds agreement and no-derivatives ones. A source whose class (data/licences.json) the recipe does not admit is dropped, and the type's licence becomes the recipe's. The flow refuses a run that trains on a source its recipe does not take (tools/flow.py --recipe), and every flow run writes the PROVENANCE.json of its data.

inputs.name: data
inputs.what: Any data whose sources carry licence classes.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: The same data with only the admitted sources.

params.name: recipe
params.what: the recipe of data/recipes/, from the most to the least restricted use it serves
